name: Foothills
description: Row upon row of rounded hills, each nearer row overlapping the one behind it, their heights rising and falling with a smooth field.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { z-index: @y; --d: @rn(0, 150, 1.6); --D: $(max(40, min(120, d))); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -40%; bottom: 0; width: 180%; height: @calc(100 + $(D))%; border-radius: 50% 50% 0 0 / @calc(100 * $(D) / (100 + $(D)))% @calc(100 * $(D) / (100 + $(D)))% 0 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
